title: Farness from low degree is at most one half
statement: Fix $n$ and an integer $d \ge 1$, and let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function. If $f$ is $\varepsilon$-far from degree $\le d$ — that is, $0 \le \varepsilon \le 1$ and every Boolean function $g$ of degree $\le d$ satisfies $\dist(f,g) \ge \varepsilon$ — then $\varepsilon \le 1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: f is ε-far from degree ≤ d (0 ≤ ε ≤ 1 and dist(f,g) ≥ ε for all degree-≤ d Boolean g)
replaced:
If $d \ge 1$ and $f$ is $\varepsilon$-far from degree $\le d$, then
$\varepsilon \le 1/2$.
